subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add a terminal admin contact inventory for WhatsApp pairing and allowlists, and what fields, redaction, account scope, and admin authorization should it expose?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-reproducible, but listing phone numbers or sender IDs with permission and activity state changes a security-sensitive admin surface and overlaps existing allowlist, directory, channel status, and narrower pairing-management work.

options.title: Define Scoped Admin Inventory
options.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges approved pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and account-scope rules.

options.title: Narrow To Pairing Management
options.body: Use issue #56621 as the first step for approved-pairing list and revoke, and defer group-policy and last-active columns until privacy and storage semantics are decided.

options.title: Defer To Control UI Design
options.body: Keep terminal surfaces as-is until a broader Control UI/admin permission model owns contact inventory and management.

recommendation.title: Define Scoped Admin Inventory
recommendation.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges approved pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and an explicitly chosen activity source under redaction and account-scope rules.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest combined history across allowlist commands, pairing CLI behavior, allowFrom storage, and security-sensitive product-boundary routing.
